{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose a login prompt reachable via telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is confirmed.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A host TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarded to the guest login service"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must remain running in the background after launch","Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 must present a login prompt","The prompt must be observed before finalization"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying that files exist","Only verifying that QEMU starts without checking the telnet prompt","Leaving QEMU in the foreground","Using a port that is open but does not show a login prompt"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts","Launch QEMU with user networking and hostfwd from 127.0.0.1:6665 to guest port 23 or serial console as needed","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed","Keep the VM running after successful probe"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed launch command showing QEMU started in background","Receipt-backed probe showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["If the ISO boots to a serial console instead of telnetd, adjust QEMU console/forwarding so the login prompt is reachable on the requested port."]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect visible files and any prior receipts for launch details","Determine whether QEMU is installed and what invocation is available","Start QEMU detached/backgrounded with the ISO and port forwarding","Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt appears","Leave the VM running once ready"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout":120000}]}
